Claude: a project brief with 20 ideas and no clear first step? 🧩

Give the ideas a shape.

Paste your notes and ask: “Group these into goals, tasks, and open questions. Use only the details I’ve provided.”

You get a draft you can work through one section at a time.

Here’s how to turn that structure into a small project plan. 1/3
